description: Arguments of `set_schedule`: the `ScheduleDef` fields to change, others kept.

columns.description: The columns, in order: field names ("level", "name", "volume", ...).

family.description: Only elements of this material family ("concrete", "steel", ...); null: every family.

group_by_level.description: Rows grouped by level, a subtotal under each.

name.description: The schedule's name (built-in or the model's own), case-insensitive.

title: SetScheduleArgs
